breaking_news.headline: Ferrari unveiled its first EV model. The response has been lukewarm
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to Mack Hogan of Inside EVs about the lukewarm consumer response to Ferrari's first electric vehicle.

breaking_news.headline: These swing voters are adding high gas prices into their political calculations
breaking_news.summary: As part of NPR's Swing Shift project checking in with swing voters, these Americans are split on who is to blame for high gas prices but they all agree it has an impact on their personal finances.

breaking_news.headline: Trump wants a gas tax holiday. There's a much bigger problem looming
breaking_news.summary: Suspending the federal gasoline tax could save drivers up to 18.4 cents per gallon. But it would drain the fund meant to cover roadbuilding and repairs — a fund that's already in trouble.

breaking_news.headline: This is how close American households are to the financial edge
breaking_news.summary: A new report shows that nearly half of U.S. households did not earn enough to cover their necessities in 2024.

breaking_news.headline: FIFA's World Cup ticket sales outraged fans. Now they are under investigation
breaking_news.summary: FIFA has always had a peculiar way to sell tickets to the World Cup. It never faced any major issues — until prices soared for the 2026 tournament.

breaking_news.headline: CBS' Bari Weiss overhauls '60 Minutes,' fires top producer and reporters
breaking_news.summary: The new head of CBS News is flexing her muscles at the network's most storied news program: "60 Minutes." We look at the upheaval.

breaking_news.headline: Here's how we're coping with high gas prices, according to Costco and Walmart
breaking_news.summary: Sky-high gas prices have drivers going out of their way for discounts at the pump. Oil executives warn that even higher prices might be on the horizon.

breaking_news.headline: United Airlines flight to Spain pulls U-turn, apparently over Bluetooth device name
breaking_news.summary: The flight to Palma de Mallorca diverted back to Newark late on Saturday. Air traffic audio and social media posts indicate an onboard Bluetooth device raised security concerns.

breaking_news.headline: Dead whale towed ashore in Denmark ahead of autopsy
breaking_news.summary: "Timmy" was found dead off the coast of Anholt despite multiple attempts to rescue it.

breaking_news.headline: South Africa made to look like fools over World Cup visa issues, says minister
breaking_news.summary: After a day of uncertainty, the government confirms the team will depart for Mexico on Monday.

breaking_news.headline: Hundreds arrested and dozens of police injured after Champions League riots in France
breaking_news.summary: Nearly 800 people were arrested after clashes with police which saw 219 people injured, including 57 police officers.

breaking_news.headline: Huge blast kills dozens in rebel-held village in Myanmar
breaking_news.summary: Insurgents say it was caused by explosives being used for mining close to the Chinese border.

breaking_news.headline: Japan defence minister denies militarism and criticises China's 'huge arsenal'
breaking_news.summary: Shinjiro Koizumi makes some of Tokyo's most pointed remarks yet in the dispute over Japan's military build-up.

breaking_news.headline: Trump seeking edits to US-Iran deal, US media report
breaking_news.summary: The requested changes are related to the Strait of Hormuz and the removal of highly enriched uranium, according to US media.

breaking_news.headline: Colombia presidential runoff pits leftist senator against pro-Trump rival
breaking_news.summary: Left-wing senator Iván Cepeda will face Trump admirer Abelardo de la Espriella at the final ballot on 21 June.

breaking_news.headline: Israel seizes castle in Lebanon as it expands ground offensive
breaking_news.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu calls the capture of the strategic fortress a "decisive shift" in Israel's campaign against Hezbollah, as European governments criticise the escalation.

breaking_news.headline: How a borough in Merseyside is bucking the UK's youth unemployment trend
breaking_news.summary: Could personalised early intervention help prevent under-16s falling into the Neet trap?

breaking_news.headline: Why Britain's notoriously bad train wi-fi might soon be a thing of the past
breaking_news.summary: How bad is the signal on our trains? We spoke to commuters to find out.

breaking_news.headline: Caribbean hot sauce producers warn of shortages and higher prices
breaking_news.summary: Manufacturers in Jamaica say the key chilli peppers they need are in limited supply.

breaking_news.headline: Arrive three hours before flight home, airline boss tells UK holidaymakers
breaking_news.summary: Wizz Air CEO Yvonne Moynihan also advises passengers to carry portable chargers and water due to lengthy queues.
